data.exact_reserve_text: In 2015, there has been an overall surplus in ultimate claims of GBP 27.1m (2014: GBP 28.0m) due primarily to a reduction in the assessment of third party liability claims on the 2013 and prior accounts following lower than expected incurred claims movements during 2015 and a release of catastrophe loads on 2014 year of account as policies come off risk (2014: better than anticipated experience in medical malpractice, a deterioration on motor lines of business and a release of catastrophe loads on 2013 year of account).

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported an overall net surplus in ultimate claims of GBP 27.1 million for 2015, primarily driven by a reduction in third party liability claims for the 2013 and prior accounts due to lower than expected incurred claims movements. Additionally, there was a release of catastrophe loads for the 2014 and 2013 years of account as policies came off risk, indicating better than anticipated experience in medical malpractice for 2014. However, this was partially offset by a deterioration on motor lines of business for 2014.
